Set of 2 Silver Blue Meena Elephants Medium

Bring home timeless elegance with this Set of 2 Silver Blue Meena Elephants (Medium – 9.5 cm) – a stunning representation of artistry and tradition. Crafted with precision, these elephants feature a brilliant silver finish adorned with royal blue meenakari detailing that highlights their intricate patterns and majestic posture.

The elephants’ raised trunks symbolize victory, good fortune, and positivity, making them a perfect addition to your home décor. Their medium size makes them versatile for tabletops, showcases, pooja rooms, center tables, or office desks, where they serve as a statement of luxury and auspiciousness.

Made from high-quality metal with fine enamel work, these pieces are durable, easy to maintain, and designed to retain their shine for years. They are perfect as housewarming gifts, festive presents, wedding favors, or corporate gifting solutions, leaving a lasting impression with their regal appeal.

This pair doesn’t just enhance your interiors but also reflects your appreciation for Indian craftsmanship and heritage, turning any space into a more welcoming and sophisticated setting.
